free_tier.stated: No upload fee is stated and no total storage quota is stated; a free account is required. A single file should not exceed ~500 to ~700 GB (500 GB recommended) and an item should hold fewer than 10,000 files.

per_object_cap.stated: A single file in an item should not be larger than ~500 to ~700 GB; 500 GB is the recommended lower limit.

limits.value: ~500 to ~700 GB per file (500 GB recommended)

limits_note: Items should hold fewer than 10,000 files with no file above 1TB; the page states the API allows up to 250,000 files, and a browser upload that fails on a network interruption shows a Resume button.

identity_cost.detail: a free archive.org account is required before uploading; sign-in uses the account email address and a password

reliability_note: A browser upload that fails on a network interruption shows a Resume button; a failed upload can instead show a 503-slowdown-spam message, for which the page gives no cause.
confidence_note: The 2026-11-03 evidence rows read https://help.archive.org/help/uploading-troubleshooting/ (per-file size, 10,000-file item guidance, Resume button, 503-slowdown-spam), https://help.archive.org/help/archive-org-information/ (no upload fees) and https://help.archive.org/help/uploading-a-basic-guide/ (free account required). Every field that decides the verdict cites those captures.
